## prevent-damage-by-source

## cant-be-countered

Blocks **1** card.

- **(static_effect)** a static ability on a permanent that makes *other* spells uncounterable -- a `cant_be_countered` static whose filter picks the spells it protects (here every spell its controller controls), consulted by the `counter` op against the stack item's controller and characteristics rather than against the casting card's own printed flag, so that a spell cast after this creature is already on the battlefield survives being countered
  <br>Why the existing vocabulary won't do: The engine's only uncounterable-ness is the card-level `uncounterable` boolean (src/commanderblitz/cards/schema.py -> src/commanderblitz/engine/carddef.py), which the `counter` op reads straight off the spell's own registry definition (src/commanderblitz/engine/effects/ops_stack.py) -- it is a printed property of one card, so it can say line 1 ("This spell can't be countered") and nothing more; it cannot be granted, and there is no filter or controller on it. Nothing in `static_effects` reaches the stack at all: `ward` and `protection` are the closest, and both tax or forbid *targeting* a permanent while leaving countering untouched, and `spell_cost_reduction` is the only static that looks at spells and it only changes their price. As docs/card-dsl-cookbook.md, "Target opponent and up to one target creature they control" says outright, statics do not reach a spell on the stack, so this needs new plumbing in the `counter` op, not a new card field.

<details><summary>Cards waiting on this</summary>

- **Hexing Squelcher** (rank 717) — `hexing_squelcher`
  - Spells you control can't be countered.

</details>

## conditional-mana-ability

Blocks **1** card.

- **(engine)** a mana ability whose production is switched by a condition on its source at activation time -- "Add {C}; if this has a luck counter on it, instead add one mana of any color". `mana_options_of` and the payment solver must be able to evaluate a per-branch condition against live game state (here `counters_on` for a luck counter on the source) and offer only the branch that is currently true, in both the automatic tap path and the manual-mana path
  <br>Why the existing vocabulary won't do: `_split_mana_rider` (src/commanderblitz/cards/loader/mana.py) allows only leading `add_mana`/`choose_mode` effects plus a rider drawn from MANA_RIDER_OPS = {add_counters, add_poison, damage, gain_life, lose_life, remove_counters}; `if` is not in that set, so the printed conditional is a load error, not a card. `_mana_options` freezes production into a fixed tuple of 6-tuples at load time and `_mana_amount` may only scale one `add_mana`'s symbols, so no state can change *which* symbol is produced -- only how many. The three state-dependent forms that do exist (`mana_reflects`, `mana_identity`, `mana_chosen_color`) are each hardcoded questions about the board, the command zone or the permanent's chosen colour, and each is required to be the ability's only effect; none can be a condition on counters and none can pick between two branches. `choose_mode` is not a substitute and would be an approximation, because a mode is a free choice at activation: the land would offer any colour with no luck counter on it. Splitting the line into two mana abilities gated by `activation_condition` is silently wrong rather than merely ugly: `costs._sources_of` (src/commanderblitz/engine/costs.py) collects solver mana sources on `solver_taps` plus tapped/summoning-sickness/abilities_locked alone and never consults `activation_condition`, so the payment solver would happily tap the counter-less Caverns for any colour; `activation_condition` is only read on the offered-action path in `legality` (src/commanderblitz/engine/legality.py). It would also leave one printed line claimed by two abilities, which the residual gate reads as text nobody owns.

<details><summary>Cards waiting on this</summary>

  - If this card is in your opening hand and you're not the starting player, you may begin the game with Gemstone Caverns on the battlefield with a luck counter on it. If you do, exile a card from your hand.
  - {T}: Add {C}. If Gemstone Caverns has a luck counter on it, instead add one mana of any color.

</details>

## delirium

Blocks **1** card.

- **(value)** a static-legal counting leaf for the number of *distinct card types* among the cards in a zone -- the natural spelling being `{"distinct": {"of": "card_type", "objects": {"zone": "graveyard", "controller": "you"}}}`, i.e. a third `DISTINCT_OF` entry beside `power` and `basic_land_type` (src/commanderblitz/engine/effects/values.py, DISTINCT_OF) that counts the union of `card.types` over the pool, plus admission of `distinct` into `STATIC_VALUE_KEYS` (src/commanderblitz/cards/loader/vocabulary.py) so a static `condition`'s `cmp` can hold it. That one leaf turns on every delirium card at once -- the printed clause is always "four or more card types among cards in your graveyard" -- and the same leaf reads "the number of card types among cards in your graveyard" on the effect side (Traverse the Ulvenwald, Emrakul's Evangel-style scaling), so it wants to land in `VALUE_KEYS` too.
  <br>Why the existing vocabulary won't do: `count` is the closest and is the wrong measurement: it counts *objects* matching a filter, so a graveyard of four creature cards reads 4 and satisfies a `>= 4` that delirium must reject, while a graveyard of one instant, one land, one artifact and one creature also reads 4 and passes by coincidence. That is the same distinction `values.py` already spells out for domain -- "five Forests are five and not one". `distinct` is the leaf that does count distinct values, but it is blocked twice over: its `DISTINCT_OF` allows only `power` (coven) and `basic_land_type` (domain), with no card-type entry, and it is absent from `STATIC_VALUE_KEYS` -- which is `{const, count, mana_symbols, counters_on, permanents_entered_this_turn}` plus the life and per-player leaves -- so even with a card-type entry it could not be named inside a static's `condition`. The `zone: graveyard` support in static counting filters that makes Threshold (Nimble Mongoose, `count` >= 7) and Hellbent expressible therefore reaches the graveyard but cannot ask what is in it. The remaining temptation is to enumerate: `any` of `all`-of-`exists` nodes over every 4-subset of the card types, which is 126 branches for nine types, silently wrong the moment a tenth type is printed, and an approximation rather than the sentence. Only this clause is blocked -- the first line, "Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, surveil 1", is a plain `spell_cast` trigger filtered `not_types: ["Creature"]` with the `surveil` op, and the consequences of the delirium clause (`buff` +2/+2, `grant_keyword` flying, `attacks_if_able`) are all present static effects -- so no partial answer was written.

<details><summary>Cards waiting on this</summary>

- **Dragon's Rage Channeler** (rank 1799) — `dragon_s_rage_channeler`
  - Delirium — As long as there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, this creature gets +2/+2, has flying, and attacks each combat if able.

</details>

## multikicker

Blocks **1** card.

- **(cost)** the multikicker guard must accept a card whose only reader of 'additional_paid' is a 'self_enters_with_counters' replacement -- i.e. loader._mentions should walk model.replacements (their 'amount' and 'condition' value expressions) the way it already walks spell_effects, targets, ability effects, ability targets and trigger conditions. The same walk feeds the mirrored check just below it ('reads additional_paid but has no additional_cost'), so both should be fixed together. Nothing else is missing: with _mentions patched to see replacements, the card {multikicker: "{2}", replacements: [{event: self_enters_with_counters, counter: "charge", amount: {additional_paid: true}}], plus a mana ability {op: add_mana, mana: "{C}", amount: {counters_on: {counter: "charge", objects: {self_only: true}}}}} passes schema, compile, residual and playable, and the sandbox measures 6 charge counters (MAX_ADDITIONAL_TIMES) -- so the fix is one walk, and the answer that follows it asserts counters {kind: "charge", amount: 6}.
  <br>Why the existing vocabulary won't do: The printed 'Multikicker {2}' line has exactly one claimant -- the card-level 'multikicker' field (verify._covered matches it against card.multikicker; fidelity declares it). Spelling it as 'additional_cost' + 'additional_optional' + 'additional_repeatable' loads, but leaves the printed line unclaimed at the residual gate, and gate 5 only casts the card multikicked when card.multikicker is not None, so the kicks would never be paid or measured. But setting 'multikicker' fails compile with "has a 'multikicker' cost that no effect reads via 'additional_paid'", because loader._mentions never descends into model.replacements -- and a replacement is where 614.1c requires 'enters with a charge counter ... for each time it was kicked' to live. The only shape that satisfies the guard is a 'self_enters' triggered ability running add_counters {additional_paid: true}, which loads and would probably pass every gate while being the wrong card: the artifact would be seen on the battlefield at zero counters, the counters would arrive from a separate object on the stack that can be responded to or removed, and they would fire counter_placed watchers that a replacement does not. That is the approximation the brief forbids, so no answer is written.

  <br>Why the existing vocabulary won't do: This is the part that makes the gap invisible rather than merely unbuilt. Every one of the six gates can pass on a card whose printed second half the pipeline cannot see, so the card is reported `native` with no notes while half its printing does nothing. - **(cost)** an activated-ability cost "Unattach <this Equipment>" on an ability granted to the equipped creature: paying it unattaches the named Equipment (the granting source) from the creature, and the cost is unpayable once the Equipment is no longer attached to it
  <br>Why the existing vocabulary won't do: cost_keys has tap, sacrifice, exile_self, return_to_hand and the rest but nothing that unattaches; the `unattach` op exists, but putting it in the granted ability's effects moves the payment to resolution and lets the ability be activated repeatedly (and after the Powder has moved away), which the packet notes forbid. The rest is expressible: a `grant_ability` static with affects {attached: true} granting an activated ability whose effect is `prevent_damage_permanent` on self for this turn, combat only

<details><summary>Cards waiting on this</summary>

- **Blinding Powder** (rank 17717) — `blinding_powder`
  - Equipped creature has "Unattach Blinding Powder: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to this creature this turn."

</details>

## unattacked-opponent-condition

Blocks **1** card.

- **(value)** an intervening-if condition (or value) on a 'player attacks you' trigger that asks whether the attacking player has an opponent other than you who is not being attacked this combat -- i.e. the count of the attacking player's opponents, excluding the trigger's controller, that no attacking creature (or their planeswalkers/battles) is attacking, compared > 0
  <br>Why the existing vocabulary won't do: creatures_attack_player with defending: you covers 'a player attacks you', but condition_keys and value_keys have nothing that enumerates the active player's opponents and reads who is being attacked; attacked_this_turn / attackers_this_turn / count over {binding: attackers} count creatures, not unattacked defending players, and selectors are object-based so no player-level 'not being attacked' filter exists

<details><summary>Cards waiting on this</summary>

- **Suppressor Skyguard** (rank 9126) — `suppressor_skyguard`
  - Whenever a player attacks you, if that player has another opponent who isn't being attacked, prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to you this combat.

</details>

## variable-target-count-with-minimum

Blocks **1** card.

- **(engine)** a target spec whose size the caster picks between a printed floor and ceiling -- "one, two, or three target creature cards" is 1..3, never 0 -- e.g. a `min_count: 1` beside `count: 3, up_to: true`, so the spell cannot be cast with no targets (601.2c) and enumerate_target_tuples offers subsets of size 3, 2 and 1 but not the empty one
  <br>Why the existing vocabulary won't do: target `up_to` is "zero to N" (targeting.py always appends the empty subset and loader/targets.py documents it as such), so it lets the sorcery be cast with no targets and with no creature card in any graveyard; a fixed `count: 3` without up_to forces exactly min(3, candidates) and never lets the caster choose one or two when three are available. The rest of the card is expressible: a `card_in_graveyard` target with selector {types: [Creature], zone: graveyard, controller: any} and `return_from_graveyard` with destination battlefield, controller you, counters {"-1/-1": 1}

<details><summary>Cards waiting on this</summary>

- **Aberrant Return** (rank 6551) — `aberrant_return`
  - Put one, two, or three target creature cards from graveyards onto the battlefield under your control.

</details>

## wither

Blocks **1** card.

- **(static_effect)** a global static making all damage to creatures, from every source (spells, abilities, permanents in any zone, both players'), be dealt as -1/-1 counters, as though each source had wither
  <br>Why the existing vocabulary won't do: the wither keyword exists, but a grant_keyword static can only grant it to permanents matched by affects, so damage from instants, sorceries and other non-permanent sources would still be marked normally; replace_damage only scales the amount (damage_multiplier/damage_addend) and cannot change how damage is dealt

<details><summary>Cards waiting on this</summary>

- **Everlasting Torment** (rank 5549) — `everlasting_torment`
  - Damage can't be prevented.
  - All damage is dealt as though its source had wither. (A source with wither deals damage to creatures in the form of -1/-1 counters.)

</details>

## x-cost-mana-restriction

Blocks **1** card.

- **(decision)** a mana_restriction predicate for 'spend this mana only on costs that contain {X}' that, on the activate half, asks whether the cost of the specific activated ability being paid contains {X} (e.g. '{X}, {T}: ...'), not whether the source permanent's printed mana cost does; the cast half is already {"x_in_mana_cost": true}
  <br>Why the existing vocabulary won't do: mana_restriction's x_in_mana_cost predicate is answered for activations by costs.ability_purpose off the source card's printed mana cost (card.mana_cost.x_count), and the purpose carries no reference to the ability whose cost is paid. Writing only the cast half under-permits (Palette mana could not pay an {X} activation cost, which the card allows); writing activate with x_in_mana_cost would fund any ability of a permanent printed with {X} in its mana cost, X or not, and refuse '{X},{T}' abilities on permanents without X in their mana cost

<details><summary>Cards waiting on this</summary>

- **Elementalist's Palette** (rank 4046) — `elementalist_s_palette`
  - {T}: Add {C} for each charge counter on this artifact. Spend this mana only on costs that contain {X}.

</details>

## x-dependent-spell-targets

Blocks **1** card.

- **(engine)** Casting a spell whose target selector reads the announced X ("target creature with mana value X") must announce X before declaring targets (601.2b before 601.2c): offer one cast action per payable X, each carrying the targets legal at that X, the way legality._ability_aims already does for activated abilities via _targets_read_x
  <br>Why the existing vocabulary won't do: The selector itself is expressible (mana_value {op: '=', value: {x: true}} with gain_control on the target), but casting._cast_variant enumerates a spell's targets with x=0 and CHOOSE_X is asked only after the targets are fixed; _targets_read_x is consulted for activated abilities only. Verified: the card is unplayable in the sandbox (no creature has mana value 0), and in play it could only ever target a mana value 0 creature and then pick a mismatched X

<details><summary>Cards waiting on this</summary>

- **Entrancing Melody** (rank 11545) — `entrancing_melody`
  - Gain control of target creature with mana value X.

</details>
